Method of Attack: Injecting malicious JavaScript code (web skimmers, JS-sniffer, e-skimmer) into compromised online stores to collect payment card and personal information entered on checkout pages
Exfiltrating stolen data to command and control servers
Using stolen card information to purchase goods for resale
Using VPNs to obscure real IP addresses and paying for domains and hosting with stolen cards
Impacted Systems: Hundreds of hacked online stores worldwide including Indonesia, Australia, Europe (U.K., Germany), U.S., South America

Specific infected websites include thebigtrophyshop.co.uk, rebelsafetygear.com, infinitetee.co.uk, screenplay.com, sasy420.com, adelog.com.au, getitrepaired.co.uk, geigerbtc.com, hygo.co.uk, jorggray.co.uk, iweavehair.com, ap-nutrition.com
Attack Vector: Compromised e-commerce websites where malicious JavaScript skimmer code was injected
Use of cybercriminal forums to purchase malicious scripts
VPN connections to access servers hosting stolen data
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of the message 'Success gan !' in the malicious script and skimming infrastructure
Command and control servers including magecart[.]net and others in Singapore (now deactivated)
Active GetBilling script detected on 571 web stores since 2017
Exfiltration servers actively collecting payment details
